tools_helpful.evidence: session-log turns 3-4: seeded MIGRATION-MAPPING.md (20 rows), .bootstrap-meta.json perFileMode, and the Windows.UI.Xaml->Microsoft.UI.Xaml rewrite.

tool_limitations.limitation: Rewrites only Windows.UI.Xaml->Microsoft.UI.Xaml; it does not reconcile the sample's app-wide root namespace (SDKTemplate) with the scaffold's project namespace, leaving a large, error-prone manual rename to the agent.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Document the SDKTemplate reconciliation (done) and guard it in Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 (done); optionally have the bootstrap perform the tree-wide rename deterministically.

special_apis.api: SDKTemplate namespace (Windows Universal Samples shared template)
special_apis.special_handling: The whole app (App, MainPage, every scenario Page, shared MainPage.Current/NotifyUser/NotifyType/Scenario helpers) lives in namespace SDKTemplate with x:Class="SDKTemplate.*" and xmlns:local="using:SDKTemplate". Must be reconciled with the scaffold's project namespace consistently and completely.

errors_encountered.error: Settings.xaml.cs(15,7): CS0246 The type or namespace name 'SDKTemplate' could not be found
errors_encountered.root_cause: Agent renamed SDKTemplate->BackgroundMediaPlayback across 26 files but left one stray 'using SDKTemplate;' in Settings.xaml.cs; no file declares namespace SDKTemplate anymore, so the using is orphaned.
errors_encountered.fix: Rename the sample root namespace tree-wide in one sweep (.cs and .xaml) then grep for residual SDKTemplate before building; or keep SDKTemplate consistently.

errors_encountered.error: Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Markup.Compiler.interop.targets(847,9): Xaml Internal Error WMC9999: Object reference not set to an instance of an object
errors_encountered.root_cause: Cascading symptom of the CS0246: the Settings partial class fails to compile, so the XAML compiler crashes generating the .g.cs.
errors_encountered.fix: Resolve the CS0246 (orphaned SDKTemplate reference); WMC9999 disappears once the code-behind compiles.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Agent spent the whole trial performing a manual, file-by-file SDKTemplate->BackgroundMediaPlayback rename and re-authoring XAML; timed out (results.json timeout:true) at turn 39 mid-rename before ever running the final build/validate.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: The SDKTemplate root-namespace reconciliation is a large, undocumented, unsupported manual task; the agent did it ad hoc and missed one 'using SDKTemplate;', and ran out of budget before validating.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Not resolved — trial timed out with a non-building app (score 0).
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Documenting the SDKTemplate convention + a one-sweep rename recipe in SKILL.md/MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md (reduces work and residue risk) and a deterministic orphaned-SDKTemplate guard in Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 (catches a missed spot before build).

missing_tooling.need: A deterministic root-namespace reconciliation (rename or guard) for the ubiquitous SDKTemplate sample namespace.
missing_tooling.would_have_saved: The ~30-turn manual rename and the single-line residue that failed the whole build; likely turns the trial from timeout/score-0 into a building app.
